```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Data Prep
```{r prep}
# load CSV into data frame `ledger`
ledger <- read.csv("sales_data_sample.csv")
# set ledger$OrderDate to Date class
ledger$OrderDate <- as.Date(ledger$OrderDate, format="%m/%d/%Y")
# create new column Month extracting month from OrderDate
ledger$Month <- as.numeric(format(ledger$OrderDate, "%m"))
# check the structure of the data
str(ledger)
# check the class of the data
class(ledger)

# assign ledger to sales_data in global environment
sales_data <<- ledger
```

# Charts

## Bar
```{r bar}
# Bar graph showing product and the sum of sales for each.
sales_by_product <- aggregate(sales_data$TotalSales, by=list(product=sales_data$Product), FUN=sum)
colnames(sales_by_product) <- c("product", "sales")
barplot(sales_by_product$sales, names.arg=sales_by_product$product,
main="Sales by Product", xlab="Product", ylab="Total Sales")
```

## Pie
```{r pie}
# Pie chart showing sum of sales by region
sales_by_region <- aggregate(sales_data$TotalSales, by=list(region=sales_data$Region), FUN=sum)
colnames(sales_by_region) <- c("region", "sales")
pie(sales_by_region$sales, labels=sales_by_region$region,
main="Sales by Region")
```

## Box Plot
```{r boxplot}
# Box plots for average sales by region and average quantities by region.
boxplot(TotalSales ~ Region, data=sales_data,
main="Total Sales by Region", xlab="Region", ylab="Total Sales")
boxplot(Quantity ~ Region, data=sales_data,
main="Quantity by Region", xlab="Region", ylab="Quantity")
```

## Histogram
```{r histogram}
# Histogram of the count of orders by product.
sales_by_product <- aggregate(sales_data$Quantity, by=list(product=sales_data$Product), FUN=sum)
colnames(sales_by_product) <- c("product", "count")
ggplot(sales_by_product, aes(x = product, y = count)) +
    labs(title="Count of Orders by Product", xlab="Quantity", ylab="Count of Orders")
```

## Radial Plot
```{r radial}
# A radial plot showing total sales (for all products) by month.
library(ggplot2)


sales_by_month <- aggregate(sales_data$TotalSales, by=list(month=sales_data$Month), FUN=sum)
colnames(sales_by_month) <- c("month", "sales")
sales_by_month$quarter <- ceiling(sales_by_month$month / 3)
ggplot(sales_by_month, aes(x=month, y=sales, fill=as.factor(quarter))) +
    geom_bar(stat="identity") +
    coord_polar(start=0) +
    labs(title="Total Sales by Month", x="Month", y="Total Sales") +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("1"="lightblue", "2"="lightgreen", "3"="lightyellow", "4"="lightcoral"), name="Quarter")

```
